description: This file is a shell script intended for testing Git fetch operations, including multiple remotes, fetch-all options, parallel fetches, and related configurations. It contains setup functions, multiple test cases, and expected output definitions for verifying Git fetch behavior.

methods.name: setup_repository
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository with a main and side branch.

methods.name: setup_test_clone
methods.description: Clones a repository from a local source and adds multiple remotes.

methods.name: create_fetch_all_expect
methods.description: Generates expected output for fetch-all test cases.

methods.name: create_fetch_one_expect
methods.description: Generates expected output for fetching a single remote.

methods.name: create_fetch_two_as_origin_expect
methods.description: Generates expected output for fetching a remote that is set as origin.
